objective: Calibrate BF16-resolvable DeepEmbed ChannelMix gains while reducing the attention-side RWKV gain enough to preserve the locked combined-effect bound.

authorization_basis.prior_outcome: All 1/8192 through 1/2048 FFN gains produced exactly zero BF16 final-logit delta versus the FFN-gain-zero ablation; the attention path remained material and one rank marginally exceeded the 2.0 bound.
authorization_basis.architectural_response: Use the smallest gains that can alter a BF16 unit scale and halve the attention gain so the FFN contribution can be isolated inside the same total-effect cap.

architecture.outer_ffn_placement: Gemma MLP pre-hook plus down_proj pre-hook; recurrent state scales frozen intermediate activation before down projection
architecture.bf16_resolution_basis: At a unit multiplicative scale, sub-1/256 corrections can round away in BF16; the v2 grid begins at 1/128.
architecture.zero_recurrent_identity: Zero recurrent control produces exact projected-only attention and unit FFN channel scale.
architecture.ffn_gain_zero_ablation: Keep addressed/global RWKV attention gain active while setting only outer FFN gain to zero.

causal_conditions.projected_only: Correct-row projected carrier with recurrent readout bypassed.
causal_conditions.hybrid_correct: Correct projected carrier plus correct recurrent bundle.
causal_conditions.hybrid_zero_recurrent: Correct projected carrier with every recurrent tensor zeroed.
causal_conditions.hybrid_matched_donor_recurrent: Correct projected carrier with a write-length-matched donor recurrent bundle.
causal_conditions.hybrid_layer_permuted_recurrent: Correct projected carrier with recurrent bundles cyclically shifted across all 42 layers.
causal_conditions.ffn_gain_zero: Correct projected and recurrent bundles with attention gain unchanged and DeepEmbed FFN gain set to zero.

execution.distribution: one locked source/donor pair per rank; no gradient synchronization or optimizer update

selection_rule: Select the lowest outer FFN gain passing every gate on every rank; use correct-versus-projected delta and candidate_id only as deterministic tie breakers.

stopping_rule.pass: Authorize a separately locked causal training run only for the selected BF16-visible DeepEmbed candidate.
stopping_rule.failure: Archive the signed failure and do not open native held-out or protected endpoints.
stopping_rule.always: Do not open publisher validation/test, Hard32, unused strength holdout, or native generation.
